title: Asian Languages and Cultures

sourceText.admission:
Admission Requirements

Students in good academic standing may declare this major at any time.

sections.programCompletionRequirements:
Completion Requirements

Completion Requirements

60 credits

• Core Courses (20 credits):

• Primary language (15 credits): second-year level (course numbered 203 or above) in one Asian language 

• Literature, culture, linguistics (5 credits): chosen from Asian Languages and Literature 300-400 level courses, not primarily using original-language materials. See department for list of approved courses.

• Electives (40 credits):

• Literature, culture, linguistics (10 credits): chosen from Asian Languages and Literature courses, not primarily using original-language materials. Minimum 5 credits must be in an area different from the primary language. See department for list of approved courses. 

• Language, literature, culture, linguistics (30 credits): any combination of language and/or disciplinary Asian Languages and Literature courses, subject to major's other requirements. 10 credits may be chosen from outside Asian Languages and Literature. See department for list of approved courses.

• Minimum 30 credits at the 300-400 level

• Minimum 2.00 cumulative GPA for courses applied to the major

• Minimum 30 credits taken in residence through the UW
